[
  {
    "path": "_scratch/windows-interrupted-owner-native-proposal02/asr_loading_adapter.py",
    "sha256": "635d2c22db75d12ffe6965fb656fdca47450ccbbaeb4d8cc8aaff9fcc79dd243",
    "numbered_text": [
      "1: \"\"\"Unintegrated owned-facade ASR adapter. Real authority/services stay absent.",
      "2: ",
      "3: The imported resolver is the separately qualified source, not a copy here.",
      "4: Only the pure-Python lifecycle is added; no native/model package is imported.",
      "5: \"\"\"",
      "6: from contextlib import contextmanager, ExitStack",
      "7: from dataclasses import dataclass",
      "8: from pathlib import Path",
      "9: import re",
      "10: ",
      "11: import trusted_asr_resolver as resolver",
      "12: from snapshot_lifecycle import OwnedSession, OperationFacade",
      "13: from durable_lifecycle import DurableOwnedRuntimeFactory",
      "14: ",
      "15: ",
      "16: class AdapterUnavailable(RuntimeError):",
      "17:     pass",
      "18: ",
      "19: ",
      "20: class AssetConsentRequired(PermissionError):",
      "21:     pass",
      "22: ",
      "23: ",
      "24: class NativeCleanupUnconfirmed(RuntimeError):",
      "25:     pass",
      "26: ",
      "27: ",
      "28: @dataclass(frozen=True)",
      "29: class ReleaseAuthority:",
      "30:     manifest_bytes: bytes",
      "31:     manifest_approval: resolver.ManifestApproval",
      "32:     data_root: str",
      "33:     runtime_profile_id: str",
      "34: ",
      "35: ",
      "36: @dataclass(frozen=True)",
      "37: class RuntimeProfile:",
      "38:     profile_id: str",
      "39:     device: str",
      "40:     compute_type: str",
      "41:     whisperx_fixed_vad_contract: str | None",
      "42:     capture_vad_contract: str | None",
      "43: ",
      "44: ",
      "45: @dataclass(frozen=True)",
      "46: class _OwnedASRStart:",
      "47:     # This controller-local record carries the selected admission and policy",
      "48:     # into fixed worker startup. It grants no real model or serialized permit.",
      "49:     policy: RuntimeProfile",
      "50:     usage: str",
      "51:     binding: resolver.LocalBinding",
      "52: ",
      "53: ",
      "54: @dataclass(frozen=True)",
      "55: class AcquisitionPlan:",
      "56:     choice: str",
      "57:     repository: str",
      "58:     revision: str",
      "59:     manifest_sha256: str",
      "60:     destination: str",
      "61:     assets: tuple",
      "62:     logical_bytes: int",
      "63: ",
      "64: ",
      "65: # Only reviewed application bootstrap may provide these, after external release",
      "66: # and runtime decisions. No public function accepts replacement authorities.",
      "67: # Setting one alone does not bypass the resolver's still-absent REAL_APPROVAL.",
      "68: RELEASE_AUTHORITY = None",
      "69: RUNTIME_PROFILE = None",
      "70: SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE = None",
      "71: RUNTIME_FACTORY = None",
      "72: ACQUISITION_SERVICE = None",
      "73: ",
      "74: SUPPORTED_CHOICES = tuple(resolver.MODEL_SPECS)",
      "75: TOKEN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}\\Z\")",
      "76: ",
      "77: ",
      "78: def _require(condition, message):",
      "79:     if not condition:",
      "80:         raise AdapterUnavailable(message)",
      "81: ",
      "82: ",
      "83: def policy_status():",
      "84:     \"\"\"Cheap configuration status only; never inspect a cache or import models.\"\"\"",
      "85:     return {",
      "86:         \"choices\": SUPPORTED_CHOICES,",
      "87:         \"release_authority_configured\": RELEASE_AUTHORITY is not None,",
      "88:         \"resolver_real_approval_configured\": resolver.REAL_APPROVAL is not None,",
      "89:         \"runtime_profile_configured\": RUNTIME_PROFILE is not None,",
      "90:         \"snapshot_lifecycle_configured\": SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE is not None,",
      "91:         \"runtime_factory_configured\": RUNTIME_FACTORY is not None,",
      "92:         \"acquisition_service_configured\": ACQUISITION_SERVICE is not None,",
      "93:         \"asset_readiness_checked\": False,",
      "94:         \"runtime_probe_performed\": False,",
      "95:     }",
      "96: ",
      "97: ",
      "98: def _release(choice, caller_root, *, root_kind):",
      "99:     _require(type(choice) is str and choice in SUPPORTED_CHOICES, \"Exact supported model choice required\")",
      "100:     authority = RELEASE_AUTHORITY",
      "101:     _require(type(authority) is ReleaseAuthority, \"Accepted release manifest authority is unavailable\")",
      "102:     _require(resolver.REAL_APPROVAL is not None",
      "103:              and authority.manifest_approval is resolver.REAL_APPROVAL",
      "104:              and authority.manifest_approval.purpose == \"real\", \"Real manifest approval is unavailable\")",
      "105:     _require(type(authority.data_root) is str and Path(authority.data_root).is_absolute()",
      "106:              and \"..\" not in Path(authority.data_root).parts, \"Bound data root refused\")",
      "107:     bound_root = Path(authority.data_root)",
      "108:     _require(len(bound_root.drive) == 2 and bound_root.drive[0].isalpha()",
      "109:              and bound_root.drive[1] == \":\" and str(bound_root) == authority.data_root,",
      "110:              \"Canonical local Windows data root required before any service call\")",
      "111:     _require(type(authority.runtime_profile_id) is str and TOKEN.fullmatch(authority.runtime_profile_id), \"Bound runtime profile identity refused\")",
      "112:     _require(type(caller_root) is str or isinstance(caller_root, Path), \"Explicit caller root required\")",
      "113:     expected = bound_root",
      "114:     if root_kind == \"reliability\":",
      "115:         expected = expected / \"models\" / \"whisper\"",
      "116:     else:",
      "117:         _require(root_kind == \"transcription\", \"Caller root kind refused\")",
      "118:     _require(Path(caller_root) == expected, \"Caller root differs from the externally bound profile\")",
      "119:     trusted = resolver.load_manifest(authority.manifest_bytes, authority.manifest_approval)",
      "120:     selected = next(model for model in trusted.models if model.choice == choice)",
      "121:     store = Path(authority.data_root) / \"model_assets\" / \"asr\"",
      "122:     snapshot = store / choice / selected.revision",
      "123:     return authority, trusted, selected, store, snapshot",
      "124: ",
      "125: ",
      "126: def _plan(authority, selected, snapshot):",
      "127:     return AcquisitionPlan(selected.choice, selected.repo, selected.revision,",
      "128:                            authority.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256,",
      "129:                            str(snapshot), selected.assets,",
      "130:                            sum(asset.size for asset in selected.assets))",
      "131: ",
      "132: ",
      "133: @contextmanager",
      "134: def _leased_admission(choice, caller_root, *, root_kind, consent_given):",
      "135:     _require(type(consent_given) is bool, \"Explicit Boolean download consent required\")",
      "136:     authority, trusted, selected, store, snapshot = _release(choice, caller_root, root_kind=root_kind)",
      "137:     lifecycle = SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE",
      "138:     _require(lifecycle is not None, \"Private immutable snapshot lifecycle is unavailable\")",
      "139:     # Forward the primary exception to the concrete lease on exit;",
      "140:     # ExitStack.close() would discard that exception context.",
      "141:     with ExitStack() as stack:",
      "142:         lease = stack.enter_context(lifecycle.read_lease(str(store), choice, selected.revision))",
      "143:         try:",
      "144:             admission = resolver.admit_snapshot(trusted, choice, store, snapshot)",
      "145:         except resolver.AdmissionRefusal as failure:",
      "146:             # Only the initial asset check may lead to acquisition. Constructor,",
      "147:             # inference and cleanup failures happen after this handler.",
      "148:             stack.close()",
      "149:             if not consent_given:",
      "150:                 raise AssetConsentRequired(\"Trusted local assets unavailable; explicit download consent is required\") from failure",
      "151:             service = ACQUISITION_SERVICE",
      "152:             _require(service is not None, \"Approved asset acquisition service is unavailable\")",
      "153:             # The service owns quarantine, writer locking, bounded immutable",
      "154:             # transfer, verification and atomic publication. Ignore its result:",
      "155:             # a returned path or receipt cannot replace our own fresh admission.",
      "156:             service.acquire_and_publish(_plan(authority, selected, snapshot), consent_given=True)",
      "157:             lease = stack.enter_context(lifecycle.read_lease(str(store), choice, selected.revision))",
      "158:             admission = resolver.admit_snapshot(trusted, choice, store, snapshot)",
      "159:         yield authority, lease, admission",
      "160: ",
      "161: ",
      "162: def ensure_assets(choice, *, model_root, consent_given=False):",
      "163:     \"\"\"Explicit reliability acquisition/verification; never construct a model.\"\"\"",
      "164:     with _leased_admission(choice, model_root, root_kind=\"reliability\", consent_given=consent_given) as (authority, lease, admission):",
      "165:         return {",
      "166:             \"ok\": True, \"model\": choice, \"model_root\": str(model_root),",
      "167:             \"snapshot\": admission.snapshot,",
      "168:             \"manifest_sha256\": authority.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256,",
      "169:             \"verified\": True, \"model_constructed\": False, \"ready_marker\": None,",
      "170:         }",
      "171: ",
      "172: ",
      "173: def _runtime_profile(authority, usage):",
      "174:     profile = RUNTIME_PROFILE",
      "175:     _require(type(profile) is RuntimeProfile and profile.profile_id == authority.runtime_profile_id,",
      "176:              \"Approved runtime profile is unavailable or does not match the release\")",
      "177:     # The first owner protocol is CPU-only. A future GPU profile needs its own",
      "178:     # reviewed values/qualification; neither user settings nor probing picks it.",
      "179:     _require(profile.device == \"cpu\" and profile.compute_type in (\"int8\", \"float32\"), \"Qualified CPU compute policy required\")",
      "180:     if usage == \"whisperx\":",
      "181:         _require(type(profile.whisperx_fixed_vad_contract) is str",
      "182:                  and TOKEN.fullmatch(profile.whisperx_fixed_vad_contract), \"Approved fixed VAD contract is unavailable\")",
      "183:     elif usage == \"capture_fallback\":",
      "184:         _require(type(profile.capture_vad_contract) is str",
      "185:                  and TOKEN.fullmatch(profile.capture_vad_contract), \"Capture fallback VAD is not qualified\")",
      "186:     else:",
      "187:         _require(usage == \"reliability\", \"Runtime usage refused\")",
      "188:     _require(RUNTIME_FACTORY is not None, \"Qualified runtime factory is unavailable\")",
      "189:     return profile",
      "190: ",
      "191: ",
      "192: @contextmanager",
      "193: def _model_session(choice, caller_root, *, usage, root_kind, consent_given):",
      "194:     with _leased_admission(choice, caller_root, root_kind=root_kind, consent_given=consent_given) as (authority, lease, admission):",
      "195:         profile = _runtime_profile(authority, usage)",
      "196:         factory = RUNTIME_FACTORY",
      "197:         _require(type(factory) is DurableOwnedRuntimeFactory and factory.manager is SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE,",
      "198:                  \"Concrete runtime factory must own the active snapshot lifecycle\")",
      "199:         # The exact returned permit binds this factory to this lease's local",
      "200:         # record. A generation string or a second lease cannot substitute.",
      "201:         permit = lease.begin_native_session()",
      "202:         runtime = None",
      "203:         primary_error = None",
      "204:         try:",
      "205:             # Recheck before worker startup; no native/model constructor runs",
      "206:             # in the controller. The fixed worker must enforce this binding,",
      "207:             # selected usage and VAD policy before its own construction path.",
      "208:             binding = resolver.bind_for_constructor(admission)",
      "209:             _require(type(binding) is resolver.LocalBinding and binding.choice == choice",
      "210:                      and binding.revision == permit.record.key.revision",
      "211:                      and binding.manifest_sha256 == authority.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256",
      "212:                      and binding.model_path == admission.snapshot",
      "213:                      and binding.local_files_only is True and binding.constructor_called is False",
      "214:                      and binding.real_runtime_approved is False, \"Exact local startup binding required\")",
      "215:             startup = _OwnedASRStart(profile, usage, binding)",
      "216:             runtime = factory.open_owned_session(startup, permit)",
      "217:             _require(type(runtime) is OwnedSession and runtime._record is permit.record",
      "218:                      and runtime._manager is SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE, \"Exact owned session required\")",
      "219:             operations = runtime.operations()",
      "220:             _require(type(operations) is OperationFacade and operations._session is runtime,",
      "221:                      \"Exact revocable operation facade required\")",
      "222:             # Callers submit owned TranscribeRequest tickets and consume only",
      "223:             # passive segments inside this context. Retained facades/streams",
      "224:             # refuse further work after the session is revoked.",
      "225:             yield operations",
      "226:         except BaseException as error:",
      "227:             primary_error = error",
      "228:             raise",
      "229:         finally:",
      "230:             try:",
      "231:                 if runtime is None or runtime.close_and_join() is not True:",
      "232:                     raise NativeCleanupUnconfirmed(\"Native cleanup unconfirmed; snapshot lease must remain quarantined\")",
      "233:                 lease.confirm_native_closed()",
      "234:             except BaseException as cleanup_error:",
      "235:                 if primary_error is None:",
      "236:                     raise",
      "237:                 BaseException.add_note(primary_error, \"Owned ASR cleanup remains unconfirmed: \" + type(cleanup_error).__name__)",
      "238:                 # Preserve the first error. The outer exception-aware lease",
      "239:                 # exit retains/quarantines the still-unconfirmed reservation.",
      "240: ",
      "241: ",
      "242: def whisperx_session(choice, *, data_root, consent_given=False):",
      "243:     return _model_session(choice, data_root, usage=\"whisperx\", root_kind=\"transcription\", consent_given=consent_given)",
      "244: ",
      "245: ",
      "246: def faster_whisper_session(choice, *, model_root, usage=\"reliability\"):",
      "247:     # Ordinary reliability/caption execution can never opt into acquisition.",
      "248:     return _model_session(choice, model_root, usage=usage, root_kind=\"reliability\", consent_given=False)"
    ]
  },

    "numbered_text": [
      "1: 2026-09-13. Concrete splices against the hash-bound working sources in SOURCE-BINDINGS.json. These are reviewable replacements, not an applied or complete migration patch. The new adapter file is implemented; the external ports and runtime profile remain unavailable.",
      "2: ",
      "3: In whisper_runner.py, import the new adapter and stop the two module-level side effects: `_PACKAGED_DECODER_DLL_HANDLE = _register_packaged_decoder_dlls()` at line 73 and `_WHISPERX_AVAILABLE = _probe_whisperx()` at line 137. Move decoder registration and the actual package import into the approved owned runtime factory. Health/status must report cheap configured policy plus last qualified runtime evidence; do not replace a real availability claim with a bare conjunction of non-None globals. The current probe/helper functions must not remain a bypass that the shipped profile calls directly. Legacy Hub-cache structural status may remain separately labeled but may not authorize construction.",
      "4: ",
      "5: Replace the acquisition/import/device/constructor block in transcribe_audio (current lines 403-439) and its optional speaker block with this bounded session shape. Keep the existing audio input checks, normalization and transcript assembly. Reject diarize=True before any acquisition/runtime call because the speaker scope is still blocked. This does not silently claim a requested speaker run succeeded.",
      "6: ",
      "7: ```python",
      "8: if diarize:",
      "9:     raise RuntimeError(\"Speaker attribution is unavailable in this release profile\")",
      "10: # UNMET PRECONDITION: waveform must come from the owned validated decoder.",
      "11: # That executable decoder/lifetime contract is not supplied by this proposal.",
      "12: with asr_loading_adapter.whisperx_session(",
      "13:         model_size, data_root=data_root, consent_given=consent_given) as model:",
      "14:     result = model.transcribe(waveform, language=language)",
      "15:     segments = list(result.get(\"segments\") or [])",
      "16:     detected_lang = result.get(\"language\") or language or \"en\"",
      "17:     shaped_segments = _shape_segments(segments)",
      "18: # Keep the current output keys/model/language/generated_at, using shaped_segments",
      "19: # and diarization_ran=False. No alignment or diarization method is invoked.",
      "20: ```",
      "21: ",
      "22: The waveform variable is deliberately not obtained from a filename fallback. It must be a bounded 16-kHz mono finite waveform with the owned decoder's required representation and lifetime, admitted under the eventual fixed media/runtime contract. No owned decoder implementation or native decoding qualification is supplied here. Do not substitute str(audio_path), whisperx.load_audio or another unreviewed file-decoding helper to make the splice executable. The prior Pipeline generator/source qualification did not qualify decoding. Reliability's existing file-input path likewise needs its separate owned media/decoder disposition before native execution; this source-only adapter does not grant it.",
      "23: ",
      "24: Remove `_prepare_model_snapshot`/`_download_model_snapshot` from the shipped execution/acquisition route. The adapter owns the single explicit-consent acquisition attempt, receives its exact plan from release authority, and never invokes faster_whisper.utils.download_model. A runtime/model failure must not fall back to those old helpers. Replace early server/runtime preflight error text with a specific approval/runtime-unavailable result when no accepted profile exists; no download modal can resolve absent release authority.",
      "25: ",
      "26: In uoink_reliability.py, replace `_load_model` with a context-returning adapter seam. This changes a private helper's return contract, so the later implementation brief must identify every existing test that mocks that helper; this task changes none of them. The public transcript/span behavior stays unchanged. The ordinary False path is refused rather than translated into a constructor download.",
      "27: ",
      "28: ```python",
      "29: def _load_model(model_name, model_root, *, local_files_only=True,",
      "30:                 _usage=\"reliability\"):",
      "31:     if local_files_only is not True:",

      "33:     return asr_loading_adapter.faster_whisper_session(",
      "34:         model_name, model_root=model_root, usage=_usage)",
      "35: ```",
      "36: ",
      "37: In transcribe_media, keep the `_transcribe` test seam unchanged. The real branch must consume segments before its model context exits:",
      "38: ",
      "39: ```python",
      "40: with _load_model(model_name, model_root, local_files_only=True,",
      "41:                  _usage=\"capture_fallback\") as model:",
      "42:     segments, _info = model.transcribe(",
      "43:         str(media), beam_size=1, best_of=1, vad_filter=True)",
      "44:     return _transcript_entries_from_segments(segments)",
      "45: ```",
      "46: ",
      "47: In detect_unreliable_spans, keep the `_transcribe` seam and threshold/span formatting unchanged. The real branch performs `_words_from_segments` inside the lease:",
      "48: ",
      "49: ```python",
      "50: with _load_model(model_name, model_root, local_files_only=True) as model:",
      "51:     segments, _info = model.transcribe(",
      "52:         str(audio), language=\"en\", word_timestamps=True,",
      "53:         beam_size=1, best_of=1)",
      "54:     word_rows = _words_from_segments(segments)",
      "55: return _cluster_low_words(word_rows, threshold)",
      "56: ```",
      "57: ",
      "58: Replace ensure_model's constructor and .pt-marker writes with:",
      "59: ",
      "60: ```python",
      "61: def ensure_model(model_name=DEFAULT_MODEL, model_root=None, *,",
      "62:                  consent_given=False):",
      "63:     return asr_loading_adapter.ensure_assets(",
      "64:         model_name, model_root=model_root, consent_given=consent_given)",
      "65: ```",
      "66: ",
      "67: In server.py `_handle_reliability_model_download` (current line 13916), the explicit user-triggered POST passes `consent_given=True`. Preserve its model validation and token/route protections. The response must report `assets_verified` from the returned verification result, not blindly set downloaded=True or claim a model was loaded. No constructor ran, and a previously accepted snapshot may have needed no transfer. A metadata sentinel is neither consent for a future request nor asset authority. Existing settings estimates remain dated estimates; no new source/model is added.",
      "68: ",
      "69: The ordinary server capture/reliability callers continue to pass the explicit model root. Do not treat `allow_model_download=True` on the compute endpoint as a model constructor permission: it currently only bypasses one status precheck, while the lower loader remains local-only. The server's asynchronous job/status/UI details need a bounded product patch after these ports are concrete; these splices do not claim that work is finished."
